text:
incident-bot: PAGER — SEV P1: increased error rate for streaming + function-calling in prod (us-west-2). Paging @alex (on-call). See /incidents/1764567890.

alex (oncall): acked. starting triage. hit by alerts: stream-error-rate > 5% (1m), 502 spikes on stream-proxy, multiple customer support tickets.

sarah (SRE): I'm pulling the ingress/load metrics + envoy logs. hitting a bunch of `SSE disconnect` traces. adding context in-thread.

morgan (eng-runtime): joining. quick question — is this across all models or just tool-call flows?

alex (oncall): initial look shows most errors have `parse_tool_call` in the stack. seems heavily concentrated on requests that include function-calls (tool_call metadata).

priya (eng-ml): pasting a sample error from the function-call parsing failures:
```
2026-03-15T12:03:22.123Z ERROR parse_tool_call: json.Unmarshal error: unexpected EOF
request_id=01F8Z7XQ2T user=acme-corp client_sdk=js/1.1.0 stream_connection=ws-789
stack=runtime/json: invalid character '\\n' in string literal
```

carla (cust-success): we have 3 customers reporting partial responses — they see "[STREAM CLOSED]" after some tokens. two are using older JS SDK versions. pinged them for exact SDK versions.

morgan (eng-runtime): grep from service logs (stream-parser) shows high rate of `unexpected EOF` + `client disconnected` events within the same timespan:
```
# aggregated sample
12:02:58 stream-parser[pid=2231] WARN client_disconnect id=ws-123 reason=read ECONNRESET
12:03:01 stream-parser[pid=2231] ERROR parse_tool_call id=ws-123 err="unexpected EOF"
12:03:05 proxy[envoy] WARN upstream_response_timeout route=/v1/stream
```

alex (oncall): mitigation idea: temporarily disable function-calling over streaming for client versions < 1.2.0, fallback to non-streaming function-calls (HTTP request/response). can we gate that quickly?

morgan (eng-runtime): we have a rollout flag `stream.fncall.enabled_by_client_version`. I can push a narrow release to flip off for versions below 1.2.0. will prepare canary.

deploy-bot: triggered release 2026.03.15-rtv02 for service stream-router — canary (10%) -> waiting approval.

priya (eng-ml): hypothesis list (in-thread):
1) client SDK bug: older JS SDK sends malformed function_call JSON with embedded newlines -> runtime parser fails (unexpected EOF).
2) proxy/truncation: Envoy or stream-proxy is trimming/chunking SSE frames incorrectly leading to partial JSON arriving.
3) congestion-induced client disconnects + incomplete frames -> parser error logged on server.

alex (oncall): collecting timeline (from logs + alerts):
- 12:01:58 UTC: stream-error-rate begins to climb
- 12:02:30 UTC: first 502s reported by streaming health checks
- 12:03:22 UTC: spikes of parse_tool_call unexpected EOF (see sample)
- 12:04:10 UTC: Customer A reports partial stream closed (sdk js/1.1.0)
- 12:05:00 UTC: canary release rolled to disable fncall for <1.2.0 (mitigation A)
- 12:07:30 UTC: error-rate drops to baseline for affected customers

morgan (eng-runtime): running audit across edge proxies for TCP-level resets / keepalive drops. preliminary shows a few nodes had mid-roll kernel update at 12:00 that caused brief connection resets on 3 hosts. correlates with client_disconnect traces.

priya (eng-ml): that supports hypothesis 3. but why parse errors with EOF? if a connection resets mid-frame, the parser may read incomplete JSON and fail. older SDKs might be less resilient to chunked SSE frames.

carla (cust-success): Customer B says they downgraded from js/1.2.1 to 1.1.0 yesterday for compatibility. so lots of traffic from 1.1.0.

alex (oncall): mitigation notes:
- immediate: disable function-calling streaming for client versions <1.2.0 (done, canary -> 100% in 6m).
- short-term: enable server-side tolerant parser that rejects only the tool-call block (returns meta error, continues stream).
- medium: communicate to customers to upgrade SDKs.

morgan (eng-runtime): deployed the gate across all stream-router pods at 12:05:00 UTC. verified config: `stream.fncall.enabled_by_client_version = ">=1.2.0"`.

priya (eng-ml): added a quick tolerant parser patch to master (handles truncated function_call payloads gracefully) — not yet rolled. code snippet: 
```go
// tolerant parse: return parse error only for tool_call and do not close stream
if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &fc); err != nil {
  log.Warn("tool_call parse failed, returning tool_error", "err", err)
  sendStreamEvent({type: "tool_error", message: "tool call parse error"})
  continue // keep the stream open
}
```

alex (oncall): handoff in 15. I'm going to stand this down to watch + escalate to eng-runtime for postmortem. next oncall @sarah (SRE) — summary: SEV1, streaming fn-call parsing errors from truncated frames and client SDK older than 1.2.0. mitigation: gate deployed, errors down.

sarah (SRE): ack. I'll take over for post-incident coordination and RCA. please drop final logs/traces + any customer-specific correlation IDs here.

morgan (eng-runtime): adding root cause draft:"kernel updates on 3 edge nodes caused transient TCP resets -> some clients (notably older JS SDKs) emitted function_call frames split across chunks -> stream-parser attempted to parse incomplete JSON and logged unexpected EOF -> clients saw stream closed or partial payloads"

priya (eng-ml): action items: [ ] roll tolerant parser to stable track [ ] postmortem with timeline + affected customer list [ ] document SDK robustness guidelines for SSE chunking and webrtc polyfills

carla (cust-success): I'll send upgrade notes + list of affected customers. Customer A asked for a postmortem and timeline; please include exact window and mitigation steps.

alex (oncall): last check: alerts quieted at 12:07:30 UTC. switching pager to watch mode. flipping channel to updates-only.

incident-bot: Incident status changed -> mitigated. SEV P1 -> monitored. Incident record: /incidents/1764567890/status.

sarah (SRE): I'll schedule the RCA writeup. tagging owners: @morgan for runtime root cause, @priya for parser & hypothesis validation, @carla to confirm customer impact list.

morgan (eng-runtime): will collect kernel update window + kube node rollout plan and attach logs to the RCA.

priya (eng-ml): will reproduce with instrumented client (js/1.1.0) and stream large function_call payloads to confirm truncation scenario.

carla (cust-success): prepping customer comms. thanks team. :white_check_mark:

-- end of thread --
